Exceptional brands. Unforgettable moments. Our unparalleled global portfolio of 45+ hotel brands spanning segments is at the heart of hospitality's most diversified ecosystem. Bold and ever evolving, our offer reaches beyond the traditional hotel model to expand our art of welcome. With compelling dining, holistic wellness, seamless working, captivating entertainment, and curated private rentals, we reimagine and continuously transform hospitality to craft exceptional experiences for our clients and drive value for our partners and all stakeholders. Bringing it together, the ALL Accor booking and loyalty platform deepens engagement and drives growth, while business solutions harness our world-class expertise and technical excellence to optimize performance for our partners. 5,800+ Hotels 880,000+ Rooms 45+ Hotel brands 110+ Countries 10,000+ restaurants & bars 400+ entertainment venues Our Unrivaled Hotel Brand Portfolio Our Premium, Midscale, and Economy brand powerhouse, our iconic Luxury brand collection, and Ennismore's founder built Lifestyle brands form a constantly evolving and expanding offer that includes branded residential, extended stay, resorts, and more. Orient Express La Minerva, Italy Grand Mercure Hanoi, Vietnam The Most Diversified Hospitality Ecosystem Our Experience Portfolio Creating emotion. The industry's richest and most diversified portfolio answers and anticipates consumer needs for how people live, work and travel, spanning dining, wellness, working and meeting, entertainment and curated private rentals. Our experience offer transforms hotels into destinations where people connect and business performance thrives, and extends our presence beyond hotels to expand the boundaries of hospitality. DISCOVER OUR EXPERIENCES ALL Accor Booking & Loyalty Accelerating engagement. ALL Accor is the gateway to our hospitality ecosystem: a powerful booking platform and world-class loyalty program that transforms guests into loyal members, forges connections that go beyond traditional loyalty programs, and drives business growth and value for our brands and hotel owners. DISCOVER ALL ACCOR Business Accelerators & B2B Solutions Unleashing potential. Our innovative B2B services, brands and solutions deliver service excellence and deep expertise to optimize our partners’ day-to-day operations, efficiency and performance. With personalized assistance every step of the way, our solutions empower our partners to maximize business success across every hospitality touchpoint.
